meta.greeting: Mm... you're back. Stay a while.
meta.rationale: A sleepy night sky: stars blinking slowly, clouds drifting past the moon. Nothing hurries here.
meta.theme-about: sleepy starry night, soft and cosy, with no objects: a full-screen canvas of a deep violet-to-navy night sky with slowly twinkling stars, a big gentle crescent moon, drifting puffy clouds and a soft violet glow low down, drowsy 'z' letters floating up now and then; the companion resting above a soft cushion with the time in a round font, the apps as pastel pebble buttons in a floating dock; lavender, periwinkle and warm cream. Quiet and restful. (#sky, #nest, #sill)

desktop.canvas: local function cloud(x, y, s, c) g.circle(x, y, 30 * s, c); g.circle(x + 34 * s, y - 14 * s, 38 * s, c); g.circle(x + 74 * s, y, 30 * s, c) g.rect(x - 4 * s, y - 2 * s, 82 * s, 32 * s, c, 16 * s) end function draw(w, h, t) g.gradient(0, 0, w, h, "#11132e", "#3a2f72") -- stars, each breathing at its own pace for i = 0, 140 do local x, y = (i * 263) % w, (i * 151) % (h * 0.78) local a = (math.sin(t * (0.4 + (i % 7) * 0.12) + i) + 1) / 2 local r = (i % 9 == 0) and 2.2 or 1.2 g.circle(x, y, r, string.format("#fff6e0%02x", math.floor(70 + 170 * a))) if i % 23 == 0 then g.glow(x, y, 10, string.format("#fff6e0%02x", math.floor(50 * a))) end end -- the moon, a soft crescent local mx, my = w * 0.8, h * 0.2 g.glow(mx, my, 150, "#fff3d633") -- a real crescent: the moon's edge one way, the shadow's edge back local R, r, ox, oy = 64, 58, 26, -14 local c = (math.atan2 or math.atan)(-oy, -ox) local pts = {} for k = -40, 40 do local a = c + k / 40 * 2.6 local px, py = R * math.cos(a), R * math.sin(a) if (px - ox) ^ 2 + (py - oy) ^ 2 >= r * r then pts[#pts + 1] = mx + px; pts[#pts + 1] = my + py end end for k = 40, -40, -1 do local a = c + k / 40 * 1.9 local px, py = ox + r * math.cos(a), oy + r * math.sin(a) if px * px + py * py <= R * R then pts[#pts + 1] = mx + px; pts[#pts + 1] = my + py end end g.poly(pts, "#fff3d6") -- clouds drifting past for i = 0, 3 do local cx = ((i * 520 + t * (6 + i * 2)) % (w + 400)) - 200 cloud(cx, h * (0.32 + i * 0.09), 0.8 + (i % 2) * 0.4, "#c9c0ff22") end -- a soft violet glow low on the horizon g.glow(w * 0.5, h * 1.15, h * 0.7, "#8a6fd844") -- a sleepy z, drifting up now and then local zp = (t * 0.25) % 1 if zp < 0.8 then g.text(w * 0.56 + zp * 60, h * 0.5 - zp * 120, "z", string.format("#d9d0ff%02x", math.floor(200 * (1 - zp))), 22 + zp * 18, "Outfit") end end
